path.description: [restore] Path to a JSON backup file (path-confined).

action.description: 'get' (one node), 'get_batch' (by 'ids'), 'state' (accessibility), 'promote' and 'demote' (adjust retrieval strength; demote never deletes), 'edit' (replace content, keep FSRS state), 'purge' (remove content and embeddings for good; confirm=true). 'delete' is an alias for purge

confirm.description: Required for 'purge' and 'delete'. Purge removes canonical content and embeddings; legacy audit and sync records keep only opaque markers and limited metadata, so this is not verified machine unlearning.

content.description: New content for edit action. Replaces existing content, regenerates embedding, preserves FSRS state.

id.description: The ID of the memory node (for single-memory actions)

ids.description: Array of memory IDs (for get_batch action). Max 20 IDs per call.

reason.description: Why this memory is being promoted/demoted/purged (optional, for logging).

tools.description: Store status. view 'health' (default: stats, decay preview, module health, warnings), 'retention' (average, distribution, trend), 'timeline' (memories by day), 'changelog' (state-change audit trail), 'stats' (hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, lifecycle).

all_scopes.description: [stats view] Explicitly aggregate every stored scope. Default false preserves project isolation.

end.description: [timeline/changelog view] End of range (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

limit.description: Max results. timeline: default 50, max 200. changelog: default 20, max 100. stats detail lists: default 50, max 200 (aggregate counts always cover the whole store). Ignored by health and retention.

memory_id.description: [changelog view] Per-memory mode: state transitions for this memory id.

schema_introspection.description: [health view] Include the response-schema description in the output.

scope.description: [stats view] Exact normalized memory scope to aggregate (default 'user'). Ignored when all_scopes=true.

start.description: [timeline/changelog view] Start of range (ISO 8601 date or datetime).

view.description: 'health' (default): system health, stats, decay preview, warnings, recommendations. 'retention': average, distribution, trend. 'timeline': memories by date. 'changelog': state-change audit trail. 'stats': hygiene counts by type, tag, age, retention, and lifecycle, with bounded detail lists and recent tag operations.

tools.title: Memory Status

tools.description: Retrieve from memory. mode 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid keyword and semantic search. 'reason': deep pass with trust scoring, spreading activation, supersession, and contradictions; needs 'query', use when accuracy matters. 'contradictions': disagreement pairs for a 'topic'. Reading never changes strength; promote what helped via memory.

concrete.description: Literal search: no semantic expansion, reweighting, activation, or side effects. Auto-enabled for quoted strings, env vars, UUIDs, paths, and code identifiers.

context_topics.description: Optional topics for context-dependent retrieval boosting

depth.description: [reason mode] How many memories to analyze (default 20, max 50).

detail_level.description: 'brief': id, type, tags, score. 'summary' (default): the 8-field response. 'full': every field, including FSRS state and timestamps.

exclude_types.description: Node types to exclude. Reflections are excluded by default so they do not pollute factual queries.

includeCrossScope.description: Search across all project namespaces. Defaults to false; set only when cross-project retrieval is intentional.

include_types.description: If set, only return nodes of these types. Overrides exclude_types.

min_trust.description: [contradictions mode] Minimum trust for both sides of a contradiction (default 0.3).

mode.description: 'lookup' (default): fast hybrid search. 'reason': deep pass with trust scoring, spreading activation, supersession, and contradiction analysis; needs 'query'. 'contradictions': trust-weighted disagreement pairs for a 'topic', or recent memories.

rank_native_fusion.description: Experimental: fuse the post-retrieval stages as ranked lists (weighted RRF) instead of score multipliers. Default off.

retrieval_mode.description: 'precise': top results only, skips activation and competition. 'balanced' (default): the full cognitive pipeline. 'exhaustive': 5x overfetch, deep graph traversal, no competition.

scope.description: Project namespace. Defaults to 'user', so project memories never bleed into an unscoped recall.

since.description: [contradictions mode] RFC3339 timestamp; only memories updated after this are considered.

source_author.description: Investigation filter: the source author/reporter (not assignee).

source_id.description: Only this source record id (issue number or ticket id). Pair with source_system.

source_project.description: Only memories from this source project or repo, exact match (GitHub 'owner/repo', Redmine project id).

source_status.description: 'any' (default), 'valid' (currently visible upstream), or 'tombstoned' (removed upstream, kept for audit).

source_system.description: Only memories ingested from this external system, e.g. 'github' or 'redmine'. Post-filter; raise 'limit' if it thins results heavily.

source_type.description: Investigation filter: source record type, e.g. 'issue', 'comment'.

source_updated_after.description: Investigation filter: only records whose source was updated at/after this RFC3339 timestamp (inclusive).

source_updated_before.description: Investigation filter: only records whose source was updated at/before this RFC3339 timestamp (inclusive).

tag_prefix.description: Keep only results with a tag starting with this prefix (case-insensitive), e.g. 'meeting:' matches 'meeting:standup'. Post-filter; raise 'limit' if it thins results heavily.

token_budget.description: Max tokens for the response; content is truncated to fit. Fetch full content by id with memory(action='get').

topic.description: [contradictions mode] Topic to scope contradiction detection. If omitted, scans recent memories.

validAt.description: Only facts valid at this time: 'now', RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD. When omitted, expired and future facts stay auditable but are downranked.

receipt_id.description: Source receipt id. For replay this must be a retrieval receipt that has a frozen replay capsule.

withheld_slots.description: [replay] Receipt-local slots to remove from the frozen final context. Search is never rerun and removed candidates are never backfilled.

context.description: Current context for intention matching and predictions

token_budget.description: Max tokens for response (default: 1000). Server truncates content to fit budget. With 1M context models, budgets up to 100K are practical.

acceptedTagSuggestions.description: Accepted input-tag to existing-tag mappings from a preflight response, revalidated against current same-scope suggestions before ingest.

allowSecrets.description: Allow a detected credential to be stored for this single item. Dangerous: normally redact the value or store a secret-manager reference instead.

batchMergePolicy.description: Batch only. 'force_create' (default) keeps caller-separated items separate; 'smart' allows Prediction Error Gating against existing memories.

content.description: The content to remember. Will be compared against existing memories. (Single mode)

forceCreate.description: Force creation of a new memory even if similar content exists

items.description: Batch mode: up to 20 items to save, each force-created unless batchMergePolicy='smart'. Use at session end or before context compaction.

acceptedTagSuggestions.description: Explicitly accepted tag mappings from a prior preflight.

allowSecrets.description: Allow a detected credential for this item only. Defaults to false; do not use for ordinary session summaries.

forceCreate.description: Force creation of this item even if similar content exists

node_type.description: Type: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision

previewTagSuggestions.description: Read-only per-item tag/validity preflight; this item is not stored.

scope.description: Project namespace for this item. Overrides the batch scope when supplied.

tags.description: Tags for categorization. Similar existing same-scope tags are returned as non-mutating suggestions.

validFrom.description: When this item becomes true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, one unambiguous 'as of YYYY-MM-DD' phrase is inferred.

validUntil.description: When this item stops being true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD; after validFrom).

node_type.description: fact, concept, event, person, place, note, pattern, decision, or state. 'state' is a snapshot that rots (versions, progress, inventories): without validUntil it expires after VESTIGE_STATE_TTL_DAYS (default 30), then is downranked and marked currentlyValid=false, still auditable via validAt.

previewTagSuggestions.description: Read-only preflight. Returns same-scope similar-tag suggestions and inferred validity without storing anything.

scope.description: Project namespace for this memory. Defaults to 'user' for backward compatibility. Recall searches this namespace unless includeCrossScope=true.

source.description: Source or reference for this knowledge

tags.description: Tags for categorization. The response non-destructively suggests close existing tags in the same scope; suggestions are never auto-applied.

validFrom.description: When the fact becomes true (RFC3339 or YYYY-MM-DD). If omitted, one unambiguous 'as of YYYY-MM-DD' phrase in content is inferred and reported.

validUntil.description: When this fact stops being true. Use RFC3339 or an exact YYYY-MM-DD date; must be after validFrom.

tools.description: Inhibit a memory without deleting it (top-down suppression, Anderson 2025 and Davis Rac1): it drops out of retrieval and decays faster, each call compounds, and a background worker spreads accelerated decay to co-activated neighbours. reverse=true undoes it within 24 hours.

reverse.description: If true, reverse a previous suppression. Only works within the 24-hour labile window.
